summary: Pacebin is a compact pastebin and file upload service designed with a focus on a minimal binary footprint and straightforward configuration. It allows you to host a self-contained web endpoint for sharing text snippets and files. Because it is written in C, it provides a lightweight alternative to heavier web-based sharing tools.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you want to deploy a quick, low-resource sharing utility on constrained hardware or inside minimal containers.
watchOut: The project lacks tagged releases and has no recorded community traction, meaning you may encounter unpatched bugs or a lack of documentation. It also competes in a well-established space with many mature alternatives.
deployNotes: As a compiled C binary, it typically requires a reverse proxy such as Nginx or Caddy to handle TLS termination and usually needs persistent local storage allocated for uploaded files.
